messages.subject: Windows wizard-help wanted
parts:
I am working on adding an R-engine into the inla-program meaning that
one could define a latent model component (like f(idx, ...)) using R-
code and passing it through the formula. Similar for a new likelihood
function. This is for prototyping as its somewhat slower, but is a very
useful feature. Linux is ok, and probably also MacOS, but I am having
trouble with Windows.

I have hitting my head against the wall compiling R.dll (or R.a)
library for windows, cross-compiling it from Linux. (ie by compiling
the R-source itself.) I need to do this, as if I extract R.dll from the
Windows-binary it is stripped, meaning I cannot extract symbols to
build a 'library', as described in 

https://cygwin.com/cygwin-ug-net/dll.html


Anyone that knows how to do this? 

Best
H
